what: #150 D-108(c)(5)-(8): the approved installed extensions (name and version) of each environment. A backup whose snapshot holds any other set (an extension added, removed or at another version) fails closed and raises the production watch issue; a restore checks the restored copy against it before PINTAR may reopen. Supabase's supautils lets any database login create or drop allow-listed extensions (CLOSURE-PLAN-150.md, A7), so this is how a change is noticed. Changed only by a reviewed commit that says why.
